Opal Palace is a palace-themed Polytrack map created by TiniTheBagel, available in two distinct editions. The **original release** (~38KB) features elaborate palace scenery and the track layout as first conceived. The **Repolished edition** (~10KB) is a later rebuild that strips out the decorative scenery and refines the track layout for a cleaner, faster racing experience. Both codes are provided below.

## About This Map

Inspired by the iridescent shimmer of opal gemstones, Opal Palace recreates the grandeur of a palace setting in low-poly form. Grand archways, ornate structures, and sweeping courtyards define the scenery of the original version, while the Repolished edition distils this down to its racing essence with a tightened layout and improved flow.

<Tip>
  The **Repolished edition** is the recommended version of Opal Palace. It features an improved track layout with better flow and racing geometry compared to the original release.
</Tip>

## Import Code

To play this map, copy the full import code string for your preferred version and paste it into Polytrack's **Track Editor → Import** field.

<Note>
  Make sure you copy the **entire** code string before importing. Any truncation will cause the import to fail.
</Note>
